summary: Amer Sports, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release. Revenue rose 32% to $1,945M; adjusted operating margin expanded 160bps to 17.4%. The filing is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situation disclosure. No extraordinary corporate event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change) is announced. The 6-K serves solely to update the market on operational performance and revised guidance under Rule 13a-16. Thus it falls outside all special-situations categories.
